overview.text: Julie Bess Aimen was elected to the Circuit Court in 2020 and presides in the Domestic Relations Division. Before taking the bench, she had a solo private practice in criminal defense, family, and civil rights law, and was an assistant appellate defender. She is a past president of the Illinois Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers.
